During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], a '''watchstation''' orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serroco]]. During the [[Battle of Serroco]], [[Carth Onasi]] was able to save many [[Stereb]] lives by alerting them from the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to take refuge in Serroco's underground.
